speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Transport clear of the caldera. Core temperature rising. Geothermal containment has failed.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Transport clear of the caldera. Core temperature rising. Geothermal containment has failed.

speaker: TITAN
text: The rift is buckling. Those severed conduits are feeding the surge straight back into their power grid.
subtitle: TITAN: The rift is buckling. Those severed conduits are feeding the surge straight back into their power grid.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: The reservoirs have burst. Steam is pouring through the flues. The river is finding its bed again.
subtitle: OCEANUS: The reservoirs have burst. Steam is pouring through the flues. The river is finding its bed again.

speaker: AURA
text: Listen to the sky. That hum is breaking apart. The field that held us under glass is coming down.
subtitle: AURA: Listen to the sky. That hum is breaking apart. The field that held us under glass is coming down.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: The emitters along Sector Four are arcing. There. The shield lattice is splitting.
subtitle: MIRAGE: The emitters along Sector Four are arcing. There. The shield lattice is splitting.

speaker: SURYA
text: Confirmed on civilian channels. The sky-shield has collapsed. Their iron dome is gone.
subtitle: SURYA // COMMS: Confirmed on civilian channels. The sky-shield has collapsed. Their iron dome is gone.

speaker: KAITO
text: Ten years under a false twilight. Ten years of looking up at a shield we could never touch. No more.
subtitle: KAITO: Ten years under a false twilight. Ten years of looking up at a shield we could never touch. No more.

speaker: KAITO
text: Their low-altitude cover is gone. Stratos Docks is exposed. We have our way into the Spire.
subtitle: KAITO: Their low-altitude cover is gone. Stratos Docks is exposed. We have our way into the Spire.

speaker: KAITO
text: Regroup at the rim and rearm. We are taking the high docks. Axiom Force, prepare for insertion.
subtitle: KAITO: Regroup at the rim and rearm. We are taking the high docks. Axiom Force, prepare for insertion.
